media:group.media:title: Spark Award 2026 - Upcycling plastic waste into super glue
media:group.media:description:
On 26 November 2026, ETH Zurich presents the Spark Award. The award stands for the most promising invention, which ETH Zurich filed as a patent in the past year. The video presents one of the five finalists.
Invention: Upcycling plastic waste into super glue Inventors: Athina Anastasaki, Tae-Lim Choi, Hongsik Kim, Hyun Suk Wang
Department of Materials

entry.title: The Future of Universities: Lifelong Learning for a Radically Complex World

media:group.media:title: The Future of Universities: Lifelong Learning for a Radically Complex World
media:group.media:description:
12 November 2026 - This Global Lecture features ETH Alumnus and Founder of the World Economic Forum, Klaus Schwab, in conversation with the Vice Rector for Continuing Education of ETH Zurich, Stefano Brusoni. Join us for a timely discussion on how higher education must evolve to meet the demands of the AI age, lifelong learning and a world defined by constant change.
